## t1_and
Input(prompt=None, var=Var(name='A'), comma=False, semi=False)
Input(prompt=None, var=Var(name='B'), comma=False, semi=False)
IfGoto(cond=LogOp(op='AND', lhs=RelOp(op='>', lhs=Var(name='A'), rhs=Lit(value=1)), rhs=RelOp(op='<', lhs=Var(name='B'), rhs=Lit(value=5))), target=5)
Print(items=(Lit(value=0),), newline=True, file=None, commas=None)
Goto(target=6)
Print(items=(Lit(value=1),), newline=True, file=None, commas=None)
End()

Input(prompt=None, var=Var(name='B'), comma=False, semi=False)
Input(prompt=None, var=Var(name='C'), comma=False, semi=False)
IfGoto(cond=LogOp(op='AND', lhs=LogOp(op='AND', lhs=RelOp(op='>', lhs=Var(name='A'), rhs=Lit(value=1)), rhs=RelOp(op='<', lhs=Var(name='B'), rhs=Lit(value=5))), rhs=RelOp(op='=', lhs=Var(name='C'), rhs=Lit(value=2))), target=5)
Print(items=(Lit(value=0),), newline=True, file=None, commas=None)
Print(items=(Lit(value=1),), newline=True, file=None, commas=None)
End()

End()

Resume(next_=False, target=3)

End()

Goto(target=BodyLine(stmt=1, phys=2))

End()

Print(items=(Var(name='A'),), newline=True, file=None, commas=None)

Print(items=(Var(name='A'),), newline=True, file=None, commas=None)

Assign(target=Var(name='E%'), value=Lit(value=7))

End()

End()

## t1_icmpmat
Input(prompt=None, var=Var(name='A$'), comma=False, semi=False)
Assign(target=Var(name='B'), value=Lit(value=0))
IfInline(cond=LogOp(op='AND', lhs=RelOp(op='>', lhs=Call(name='LEN', args=(Var(name='A$'),)), rhs=Lit(value=2)), rhs=RelOp(op='<', lhs=Call(name='LEN', args=(Var(name='A$'),)), rhs=Lit(value=9))), body=(Assign(target=Var(name='B'), value=Lit(value=1)),))
IfInline(cond=LogOp(op='OR', lhs=RelOp(op='>=', lhs=Call(name='LEN', args=(Var(name='A$'),)), rhs=Lit(value=3)), rhs=RelOp(op='<=', lhs=Call(name='LEN', args=(Var(name='A$'),)), rhs=Lit(value=1))), body=(Assign(target=Var(name='B'), value=Lit(value=2)),))
Print(items=(Var(name='B'),), newline=True, file=None, commas=None)
End()

## t1_icomp
Assign(target=Var(name='A%'), value=Lit(value=5))
Assign(target=Var(name='B'), value=SingleLit(value=5.5))
IfGoto(cond=RelOp(op='<=', lhs=Var(name='A%'), rhs=Var(name='B')), target=5)
Print(items=(StrLit(value='YES'),), newline=True, file=None, commas=None)
Goto(target=6)
Print(items=(StrLit(value='NO'),), newline=True, file=None, commas=None)
End()

## t1_if

Assign(target=Var(name='B'), value=Lit(value=2))

Assign(target=Var(name='C'), value=Lit(value=5))
IfGoto(cond=RelOp(op='=', lhs=Var(name='A'), rhs=Var(name='B')), target=6)
Assign(target=Var(name='C'), value=BinOp(op='+', lhs=Var(name='A'), rhs=Lit(value=1)))
End()

## t1_ifgoto

IfInline(cond=LogOp(op='OR', lhs=RelOp(op='=', lhs=Var(name='A$'), rhs=StrLit(value='T')), rhs=RelOp(op='=', lhs=Var(name='A$'), rhs=StrLit(value='t'))), body=(Cls(), Goto(target=5)))
IfGoto(cond=RelOp(op='=', lhs=Var(name='A$'), rhs=StrLit(value='X')), target=4)
Print(items=(StrLit(value='A'),), newline=True, file=None, commas=None)
Print(items=(StrLit(value='B'),), newline=True, file=None, commas=None)
End()

Assign(target=Var(name='D%'), value=BinOp(op='+', lhs=Var(name='D%'), rhs=BinOp(op='*', lhs=ArrayRef(name='V0%', indices=(Var(name='A%'),)), rhs=ArrayRef(name='V1%', indices=(Var(name='A%'), Var(name='A%'))))))

End()

Close(num=1)
Print(items=(ArrayRef(name='V0', indices=(Lit(value=1), Lit(value=1))), ArrayRef(name='V1$', indices=(Var(name='A'),))), newline=True, file=None, commas=None)
End()

## t1_selcasechr

TrapCtl(event='TIMER', n=None, mode='ON')
Assign(target=Var(name='A$'), value=StrLit(value='Y'))
SelectCase(selector=Var(name='A$'), arms=(CaseArm(guards=(CaseValue(value=Call(name='CHR$', args=(Lit(value=88),))), CaseValue(value=Call(name='CHR$', args=(Lit(value=89),))), CaseValue(value=StrLit(value='Z'))), body=(Print(items=(StrLit(value='MATCH'),), newline=True, file=None, commas=None),)),), case_else=(Print(items=(StrLit(value='NOMATCH'),), newline=True, file=None, commas=None),))
End()
Return(target=None)

## v10_t1_icmpmat

IfInline(cond=LogOp(op='OR', lhs=RelOp(op='>=', lhs=Call(name='LEN', args=(Var(name='A$'),)), rhs=Lit(value=3)), rhs=RelOp(op='<=', lhs=Call(name='LEN', args=(Var(name='A$'),)), rhs=Lit(value=1))), body=(Assign(target=Var(name='B'), value=Lit(value=2)),))

## v10_t1_ifgoto

IfGoto(cond=RelOp(op='=', lhs=Var(name='A$'), rhs=StrLit(value='X')), target=4)
Print(items=(StrLit(value='A'),), newline=True, file=None, commas=None)
Print(items=(StrLit(value='B'),), newline=True, file=None, commas=None)

End()

## v10_t1_troncase

Tron()
SelectCase(selector=Var(name='A'), arms=(CaseArm(guards=(CaseValue(value=Lit(value=1)),), body=(Assign(target=Var(name='B'), value=Lit(value=1)),)),), case_else=(Assign(target=Var(name='B'), value=Lit(value=2)),))
End()

## v10_t1_tronerb
OnError(target=5)
Tron()
IfBlock(arms=((RelOp(op='>', lhs=Var(name='A'), rhs=Lit(value=0)), (Assign(target=Var(name='B'), value=Lit(value=1)),)),), else_body=(Assign(target=Var(name='B'), value=Lit(value=2)),))
Troff()
End()
Resume(next_=False, target=None)

## v10_t1_tronerr
OnError(target=6)
Tron()

Troff()
End()
Resume(next_=False, target=5)
